Author Guidelines

ICBR 2026 welcomes original contributions presenting significant advances, emerging concepts, experimental studies, enabling technologies, and innovative applications in biohybrid robotics and related interdisciplinary fields.

Originality and Relevance: Submissions must present original work that has not been published previously and is not simultaneously under review by another conference, journal, or publication venue. Each submission should be relevant to the scope and topics of ICBR 2026.
Language and Presentation: All manuscripts must be written in clear and professional English. Authors are responsible for ensuring that the manuscript is carefully proofread and that figures, tables, equations, and references are legible and correctly presented.
Authorship and Author Responsibility: All listed authors must have made a meaningful contribution to the work and must approve the submitted manuscript. The corresponding author is responsible for communication with the conference and for ensuring that all author names, affiliations, and email addresses entered in the submission system are complete and accurate. Changes to the author list after the submission deadline should only be made when fully justified and may require approval from the Program Chairs.
Research Integrity and Ethics: Authors must comply with internationally accepted standards of research integrity and publication ethics. Plagiarism, duplicate submission, data fabrication, falsification, inappropriate image manipulation, and improper attribution are strictly prohibited.
For research involving human participants, animals, biological tissues, cells, microorganisms, or other regulated biological materials, authors must obtain all necessary institutional approvals and informed consent where applicable. Relevant ethical approval information should be stated in the manuscript.
Authors are responsible for obtaining permission to reproduce any copyrighted material included in their submission.
Conflicts of Interest: Authors must disclose any conflicts of interest that could influence, or reasonably be perceived to influence, the submitted work. Authors should also provide accurate conflict-of-interest information through the Microsoft CMT submission system.
Registration and Presentation: For each accepted contribution, at least one author must complete conference registration and present the work at ICBR 2026. The presenting author is expected to attend the assigned oral or poster session in person and follow the presentation instructions provided by the conference.
Failure to register, submit the final version, or present the accepted work may result in its removal from the conference program and conference materials.

If you have any further questions, please don't hesitate to contact the conference secretaries by Email: ieee.icbr@gmail.com .
